description: This source file defines the FilterInvestRequestEvent class within the Goteo application's event system. It encapsulates data related to an investment request event, including payment method and response details, and provides methods to access and manipulate this data.

classes.name: FilterInvestRequestEvent
classes.description: Represents an event for filtering investment requests, holds payment method, response, and HTTP response data, and allows controlling email notifications.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the event with a payment method and a response object.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the payment method associated with the event.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Retrieves the response object associated with the event.

methods.name: getHttpResponse
methods.description: Gets the HTTP response, generating it from the method and response if not already set.

methods.name: skipMail
methods.description: Gets or sets the skip mail flag, controlling whether to send notification emails.
